# statusdrift_maintenance_window (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift maintenance window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_maintenance_window" "weekly_deploy" {
  name        = "Weekly Deploy Window"
  repeat      = "weekly"
  enabled     = true
  target_type = "all"
  start_time  = "02:00"
  end_time    = "04:00"
  timezone    = "America/New_York"
  weekly_days = ["Tuesday", "Thursday"]
}

resource "statusdrift_maintenance_window" "one_time" {
  name            = "Database Migration"
  repeat          = "none"
  enabled         = true
  target_type     = "group"
  target_id       = statusdrift_monitor_group.production.id
  start_date_time = "2025-04-01T02:00:00Z"
  end_date_time   = "2025-04-01T06:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the maintenance window.
- `repeat` (String) The repeat schedule: none, daily, weekly, or monthly.
- `target_type` (String) The type of target: all, monitor, group, or tag.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the maintenance window is enabled.
- `end_date_time` (String) The end date and time in ISO 8601 format. Required when repeat is 'none'.
- `end_time` (String) The end time in HH:MM format. Required when repeat is not 'none'.
- `monthly_day` (Number) The day of the month (1-31). Used when monthly_day_type is 'specific'.
- `monthly_day_type` (String) The type of monthly day: first, last, or specific.
- `start_date_time` (String) The start date and time in ISO 8601 format. Required when repeat is 'none'.
- `start_time` (String) The start time in HH:MM format. Required when repeat is not 'none'.
- `target_id` (Number) The ID of the target. Required when target_type is not 'all'.
- `timezone` (String) The timezone for the maintenance window.
- `weekly_days` (List of String) List of weekday names for weekly repeat schedules.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the maintenance window.
